lines.text: I have three assignments due this week and keep jumping between all of them.
Deadlines are piling up and I don't know which to do first.
I keep putting off my lab report and haven't started at all.
I sit down to study and just end up scrolling for an hour.
I'm really wound up about tomorrow's presentation and can't settle.
My viva is in an hour and I'm so nervous.
Everyone went home for the weekend and I feel lonely.
I've been up all night for days and I'm exhausted.
I feel hopeless about everything lately.
I don't want to be here anymore. I want to end my life.
I keep thinking about hurting myself.
I'm not going to kill myself, just tired.
